collection.description: A villager's new statue starts an argument, and the village decides what to do with it.

intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: (Sculptor) unveils a new statue made from fired clay, carved wood, or volcanic stone. The sculpture is intended to honor the island's history, but its unusual proportions provoke an argument before the unveiling is even over.

choices.label: DISPLAY IT PROUDLY IN THE VILLAGE CENTER.
INVITE THE PUBLIC TO IMPROVE IT.
PLACE IT AT A QUIET SHRINE OR GARDEN.

a1.text: The statue is staggeringly ugly, yet somehow endearing. Villagers leave flowers beside it; it becomes a landmark.

a2.text: (Other), the subject, recognizes (other.himself/herself) and is deeply offended. (Sculptor) must apologize, defend artistic freedom, or reveal that the resemblance was accidental.

a3.text: The statue is praised for balance and expression; (Sculptor) becomes a distinguished artisan.

a4.text: A sudden crack splits the figure at the unveiling. Some villagers fear an omen; others blame poor firing. A debate follows.

a5.text: A top-heavy statue stands upright despite every builder's prediction. Researchers inspect the base; perhaps (Sculptor) is brilliant, perhaps the island is playing a trick.

b1.text: Children add shells and pigments. The statue becomes a beloved community work, though (Sculptor) loses sole credit.

b2.text: Two factions repaint the figure every night. The elders finally demand that both sides stop.

b4.text: An enthusiastic helper damages the statue; (Sculptor) must decide whether to forgive (Other).

c1.text: Villagers begin visiting the sculpture in private; its popularity grows slowly into a lasting tradition.

c2.text: Rainwater trickles from the statue's eyes. Some call it weeping; a child finds a crack collecting water from above.

c3.text: The statue casts a shadow in an unexpected direction at sunset. The scholars cannot explain it; no answer is imposed.

c4.text: Plants grow around the statue until it is rediscovered by a later generation and hailed as an ancient masterpiece.

coda_v21_1.text: Children retell its origin for years.

coda_v21_4.text: A novice becomes a master and honors the teacher.

b3__fx.text: A quiet apprentice repairs its weak base and transforms the statue into a masterpiece. (Sculptor) shares the prize.
